title: Remaining Risks + Readiness Certification
methodology: Every item below references either a specific Google policy (verified fresh, AQ-06A/AQ-05C) or a previously-certified finding from this audit chain — nothing speculative, per the ticket's own instruction.

risk_register.title: Templated/jargon-leaking prose across 4 domains (328 leaf + 56 group + 10 category entities)
risk_register.policy_basis: Not a policy violation (reports/adsense-policy-review.json) — a Helpful Content / originality quality concern per Google's current Helpful Content guidance (verified AQ-05D).
risk_register.action_available_in_this_ticket: None — summary/seo_description are catalog fields, explicitly excluded from modification under AQ-06's regression rules regardless of policy justification.

risk_register.title: Named-author claim exists only in JSON-LD, invisible to human readers
risk_register.policy_basis: Not a policy violation — a true claim that is under-surfaced, not a false one.
risk_register.action_available_in_this_ticket: None — fixing requires a publication-layer/content change (surfacing the sentence as visible About-page text), which is outside AQ-06's review-only mandate even though it would be simple to do.
risk_register.recommended_owner: A future, small publication content update.

risk_register.title: No cookie-consent mechanism for future personalized-ads compliance
risk_register.policy_basis: Not a current violation (no ads live) — a prerequisite for compliant personalized-ads serving in consent-regulated regions once ads go live.
risk_register.recommended_owner: Pre-monetization technical work, before enabling ads.

risk_register.title: 4 dead 'View Bottle' links on Template A dish pages
risk_register.policy_basis: Not a policy violation — a UX defect, confirmed still present.
risk_register.recommended_owner: A quick publication fix, previously scoped in reports/content-quality-audit/recommended-improvements.md.

risk_register.title: Unexplained 'Pairing Strength: XX%' confidence scores
risk_register.policy_basis: Not a policy violation — a clarity/trust concern (an unexplained number can read as unsubstantiated to a skeptical reader).
risk_register.recommended_owner: A publication fix (add methodology explanation or remove), previously scoped.

risk_register.title: Wine-education-tier templated language (category-hub noun-swap sentence)
risk_register.reference: reports/site-quality-review.json; originally AQ-01, carried through every subsequent audit
risk_register.policy_basis: Not a policy violation — the same class of concern as AQ06-HC-01, smaller in scope.

risk_register.title: No food-safety/allergen disclaimer
risk_register.policy_basis: No specific Google requirement for this — a reasonable care signal for the content category, not a compliance gap.

risk_register.title: Legal pages read as generic multi-product boilerplate rather than site-specific
risk_register.policy_basis: Legitimate, common practice for a small operator — not a defect.

risk_register.title: Mobile usability and Core Web Vitals not independently measured
risk_register.policy_basis: Outside AQ-06's structured-review scope — flagged honestly rather than assumed clean or assumed broken.

would_a_manual_reviewer_likely_approve.answer: Likely yes, with one significant risk factor worth disclosing rather than omitting
would_a_manual_reviewer_likely_approve.reasoning: 0 policy violations across every category Google's Program Policies and Publisher Policies cover (AQ-06A). Real, verifiable business identity and trust infrastructure (AQ-06C). No broken/spam/placeholder-content site-quality issues (AQ-06E). The one high-severity finding (AQ06-HC-01) is a genuine, quantified risk to a favorable holistic impression (Rule 2) — a reviewer whose sampling happens to land disproportionately in the 4 affected domains could form a more negative impression than the site as a whole deserves — but it is not a policy violation, not spam, and not evidence of a low-effort or deceptive site. The overall body of work (majority-strong ingredient content, genuinely expert wine-education core, working navigation/search, real trust signals) supports likely approval, with the templated-content pattern as the clearest, most concrete thing that could cause a rejection or a request for changes if encountered.

overall_certification: PASS — no policy violations found. See reports/aq-06-final-certification.md for the full readiness verdict and severity-ranked recommendation.
